citation.short_title: Melvin-Koushki, The New Brethren of Purity (2025)

content: The Query of Kings ends with a lettrist prognostication of the duration of the Shāhrukhid state, obtained from an analysis of Shāhrukh's name (shah-i RKh, shah of 900), which the paper says proved accurate as Shāhrukh's model won out; the paper adds that Ibn Turka died a frustrated exile.
